description.content:
The Consensus Estimates package provides averages, both mean and median, of the line items from the underlying estimates, including line items such as revenue, earnings per share, dividend per share and target price. Estimates are available for both annual results and, where provided by our contributing brokers, quarterly results.

Most recent data supported.

description.content:
Use the `oauth` endpoint to generate the secure, time-limited JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) used to authorize access to APIs and components.</br></br>
To request a token, click Authorize and enter the following credentials:

* Username - Your Client ID.
* Password - Your Client Secret.
